name: branchyard
description: Set up Branchyard by interview (branchyard.toml, servers, rigs, deployments) and delegate work to child branches: spawn, watch, integrate and cancel children within your envelope.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Branchyard; delegate work to child branches
interface.longDescription: Set up Branchyard by interview: the setup skill drives `by init --json`, asks you each question and writes only validated, diffed configuration after you agree (branchyard.toml, server configurations with hashed credentials, rigs, deployments). Delegate parts of a coding task to child branches: spawn a child on its own git branch and harness, watch its status and cost, integrate its validated result, and cancel it. Requires an installed `by` CLI; delegation runs on a Branchyard branch (BRANCHYARD_BRANCH set).
defaultPrompt: Use Branchyard to set up this repository.
Use Branchyard to delegate part of this task to a child branch.
